title: Electromagnetic Induction
description: A changing magnetic field drives a current. Spin a coil in a field and you have a generator; laminate the iron core and you stop it heating itself. Unlocks Magnetite and Electrical Steel Laminations.

puzzle.goal: A coil of N turns, each of area A, spins at angular speed ω in a steady field B. The flux through it rises and falls as the coil turns, and the changing flux drives a voltage. Write the voltage ε at time t.
puzzle.name: EMF of a rotating coil
puzzle.form: N * B * A * ω * sin ( ω * t )
puzzle.ask: Find the peak voltage in volts for @{N} turns of @{A} m² spinning at 50 turns a second (ω = @{ω} rad/s) in @{B} T.
puzzle.method: The flux through the coil is NBA cos ωt; the voltage is minus its rate of change.
